1→/**
     2→ * Public API endpoint — serves widget configuration for the storefront block.
     3→ *
     4→ * Called from the theme app extension block JS to get the merchant's
     5→ * widget styling and text settings.
     6→ *
     7→ * GET /api/widget-config?shop=store.myshopify.com
     8→ *
     9→ * Response: WidgetConfig JSON (falls back to defaults if no config found)
    10→ */
    11→import type { LoaderFunctionArgs } from "react-router";
    12→import db from "../db.server";
    13→
    14→const CORS_HEADERS = {
    15→  "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
    16→  "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET, OPTIONS",
    17→  "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type",
    18→  "Content-Type": "application/json",
    19→};
    20→
    21→const DEFAULTS = {
    22→  position: "inline",
    23→  primaryColor: "#008060",
    24→  successColor: "#008060",
    25→  errorColor: "#D72C0D",
    26→  backgroundColor: "#FFFFFF",
    27→  textColor: "#202223",
    28→  heading: "Check Delivery Availability",
    29→  placeholder: "Enter your zip code",
    30→  buttonText: "Check",
    31→  successMessage: "Great news! We deliver to your area.",
    32→  errorMessage: "Sorry, we don't deliver to this area yet.",
    33→  notFoundMessage: "This zip code was not found in our system.",
    34→  showEta: true,
    35→  showZone: false,
    36→  showWaitlistOnFailure: false,
    37→  borderRadius: "8",
    38→  customCss: null as string | null,
    39→};
    40→
    41→export const loader = async ({ request }: LoaderFunctionArgs) => {
    42→  if (request.method === "OPTIONS") {
    43→    return new Response(null, { status: 204, headers: CORS_HEADERS });
    44→  }
    45→
    46→  const url = new URL(request.url);
    47→  const shop = url.searchParams.get("shop");
    48→
    49→  if (!shop) {
    50→    return new Response(
    51→      JSON.stringify({ error: "Missing shop parameter" }),
    52→      { status: 400, headers: CORS_HEADERS },
    53→    );
    54→  }
    55→
    56→  // Validate shop is a real myshopify.com domain (prevents cross-shop config enumeration)
    57→  if (!/^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9\-]*\.myshopify\.com$/.test(shop) || shop.length > 100) {
    58→    return new Response(
    59→      JSON.stringify({ error: "Invalid shop parameter" }),
    60→      { status: 400, headers: CORS_HEADERS },
    61→    );
    62→  }
    63→
    64→  const config = await db.widgetConfig.findUnique({ where: { shop } });
    65→
    66→  const payload = config
    67→    ? {
    68→        position: config.position,
    69→        primaryColor: config.primaryColor,
    70→        successColor: config.successColor,
    71→        errorColor: config.errorColor,
    72→        backgroundColor: config.backgroundColor,
    73→        textColor: config.textColor,
    74→        heading: config.heading,
    75→        placeholder: config.placeholder,
    76→        buttonText: config.buttonText,
    77→        successMessage: config.successMessage,
    78→        errorMessage: config.errorMessage,
    79→        notFoundMessage: config.notFoundMessage,
    80→        showEta: config.showEta,
    81→        showZone: config.showZone,
    82→        showWaitlistOnFailure: config.showWaitlistOnFailure,
    83→        borderRadius: config.borderRadius,
    84→        // Sanitize customCss: strip </style> close tags to prevent CSS injection
    85→        // in storefront <style> elements
    86→        customCss: config.customCss
    87→          ? config.customCss.replace(/<\/style>/gi, "")
    88→          : null,
    89→      }
    90→    : DEFAULTS;
    91→
    92→  return new Response(JSON.stringify(payload), {
    93→    status: 200,
    94→    headers: {
    95→      ...CORS_HEADERS,
    96→      "Cache-Control": "no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate",
    97→    },
    98→  });
    99→};
